stage: blocking correction, tested in complete X1 context; not polish
problem: The user reports an unconvincing wrist-to-sword relationship; local hand detail alone did not fix the pose.

competing_explanations.H1: Incoherent wrist/palm/handle construction across the three release drawings.
competing_explanations.H2: Torso/hip sequencing and body weight are the principal cause.
competing_explanations.H3: Whole-character redraw drift produces the perceived hitch.

hypothesis: Consistent closed-hand/handle construction and connected forearms across drawings5–7 will make the release read more convincingly without changing the blade path or body performance.
intended_modification: AI edits of the three local sword-arm crops, composited through explicit arm-only masks. Source alpha may change inside masks; surrounding body and weapon pixels are protected.
predicted_improvement: At native scale and normal speed the fist stays attached to the hilt and the wrist/forearm relationship reads coherently through release.
protected_variables: Native gameplay source, clocks, active window, contact curves, lunge, input, damage and other actions exact

reference.kind: Original manually specified wrist/palm/hilt construction; no downloaded sequence
reference.purpose: Closed fingers enclose handle, guard beyond thumb/index side, continuous wrist/forearm; existing blade axes retained

keys.registration: Translation only maximizing fixed-guard gold overlap; one common strip scale, no per-key rescale or anatomical warp.
Translation only maximizing fixed-guard gold overlap; one common strip scale, no per-key rescale or anatomical warp.

actual_modifications.bounds: Explicit polygons with feathered edges. Source alpha is allowed to change inside them; protected source pixels are restored exactly.

technical_result: Bounded candidate exported and exercised in paired real-game runs. Does not establish artistic quality, production acceptance or a workflow winner.

observed_improvement.objective: Edits stay bounded; the13 untouched cells and source pixels outside masks remain exact. All drawing times and native game tracks remain exact.
observed_improvement.agent_closeup_impression: Closed fingers/hilt overlap appears clearer; subjective and not a whole-action quality verdict.

regressions.observed: Glove/cuff/sleeve shading changes inside the edit masks; assess the new local seams. No outside-mask body or blade-path drift.
regressions.risk: The correction may be too subtle at normal speed, especially drawing6 whose alpha silhouette changes by only1 pixel.

remaining_problems: Unapproved surrounding poses and art/contact mismatch

agent_assessment.reason: Close-up detail improvement is insufficient evidence for a convincing normal-speed action. H01 does not address body stiffness, braking or the existing key7 whole-body drift.
